crop.visible_input_object: H&E imaging input leading into the image patch grid, with the local neighborhood/patch context and diameter feature extraction feeding the FiLM-conditioned prediction path.
crop.visible_model_interface: H&E imaging -> Image FM patch grid/context -> neighborhood aggregation / Conv & Concat -> FiLM, plus the diameter feature extraction input into FiLM.
crop.rationale: This crop keeps the visible H&E source object, the patch/context transformation, the neighborhood aggregation block, and the FiLM interface needed to interpret the H&E-to-ST prediction route. It excludes the far-right ST prediction output panel and most unrelated lower pretraining inset details while retaining the model-facing path that is actually shown in the figure.
